messages.en:
{07 00 00}Go stand in front of the
one you like. Just stand
there and mumble, OK?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Mine seisa selle ette,
mis sulle meeldib. Lihtsalt
seisa seal ja pomise, eks?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Now tell me which one!{01 01 00}
{07 11 00}No hard feelings, I promise!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Nüüd ütle mulle, milline!{01 01 00}
{07 11 00}Ma ei pane pahaks, luban!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Just go touch the one
you're thinking of,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Lihtsalt puuduta seda,
mille peale sa mõtled,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
